function.name: setup_mcp
function.description: Propose an MCP server as an inline consent card (install a catalog entry, re-enable a disabled server, or run OAuth); blocks until the user acts. Use when they ask to add an MCP or a task clearly needs a missing one. Never hand-edit mcp_servers config for them — always use this tool. Never re-ask after a decline — on declined/unanswered, continue without it. Catalog names: `mason mcp catalog` in the terminal.

server.description: Catalog name (install) or mcp_servers config name (enable/authorize).

reason.description: One sentence on the card: why this helps right now.
